in_hebrew.name: ענדיאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Andile is derived from the Hebrew language, and it means 'God is my God'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it is a common Hebrew name that expresses one's faith and devotion to God.

in_greek.name: Ανδριλεων
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Andile in Greek is transliterated as 'Ανδριλεων'. The name is derived from the Greek words 'ανδρος' (andros) meaning 'man' and 'θεος' (theos) meaning 'God'. This name signifies 'Man of God' in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Andileus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Andile is 'Andileus'. It is derived from the Latin words 'Andreas' (Andrew) and 'ius' (belonging to). So, 'Andileus' means 'Belonging to the Man of God'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it is used in the Catholic Church for saints named Andrew.
